paragraphs: Mar Huna, son of Rav Nechemiah. See the entry Huna Mar, son of Rav Nechemiah.[^1]

notes.text: The target reverses the placement of Mar: Mar Huna becomes Huna Mar. דר״נ is completed from the same notice’s full Rav Nechemiah; the exact father relationship and full heading title support this local completion.
